prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: CLOSED assembled twin-towers souvenir vessel, architectural silhouette redraw.
Image 1 is the approved STYLE REFERENCE, match this style exactly.
Draw TWO very slender, tapered stepped skyscraper keepsakes side by side. Each tower has FIVE clearly visible architectural setbacks: a broad narrow lower shaft, then successively narrower tall faceted tiers, rising into a small stepped crown and a long thin needle spire. Each tower height is roughly SIX times its average width. Silver/pale glass-blue facades, fine dark-blue horizontal window bands across every level, sparse tiny brass seam accents. The taper must extend over the full tower height, with clear shoulders in the OUTER SILHOUETTE at several heights. Pointed architectural needle tops, NOT golden domes, bottle caps, flasks, cylinders or binocular barrels. Flat small square architectural bases, NO round feet. 
A clearly visible slender enclosed SKY BRIDGE joins the towers about ONE THIRD of the way UP from the base, with a dark-navy window strip and fine brass frame. Add two thin diagonal braces under that bridge. Preserve a large open transparent gap above the bridge, making the twin skyscraper silhouette instantly legible at 120 px.
Both stepped upper crowns and spires are closed removable tops, with a fine natural architectural seam under each crown. The lower towers and bridge will be one static layer; the two tops later lift as one layer.
Loosely inspired by the impression of Petronas Towers, but an original souvenir object: change tier count, faceted rectangular plan, proportions, facade and bridge structure; do not reproduce the exact landmark design, star-shaped plan or official symbols.
Square transparent canvas, pair centered; tips around y=120, base y=900, total width about 500 px on 1024 canvas, each tower body only about 145 px wide. Front three-quarter view, simplified and elegant. No scenery, ground shadow, other buildings or people.
original design, no logos, no brand names or brand shapes, no characters, no text.
App: 時光膠囊 / Time Capsule. People send a sealed letter that can only be opened at a set time and place. Mood: tender, human, nostalgic, "precious in the AI age". Hand-inked storybook, not glossy 3D.
- Clean ink line art with a slightly hand-drawn line, flat colour fills plus one soft shading tone, a little paper grain, light hatching only (it must still read at about 120 px). Lines in plum #6E2B3F or navy #16263F.
- Palette only: ink blue #2F5D8A, light blue #5A8FD0, glass blue #DCE8F2, plum #6E2B3F, brass #C9A15A, wax red #A3364F, navy #16263F, paper #F6F8FB, cream #F3E2BB. Warm brown wood is allowed for wooden objects.
- Front three-quarter view, soft top-left light. No text, letters, numbers, logos or real brands.
- Transparent background, object centred, generous padding (object fills about 70% of the canvas), square.
Match the attached style sheet exactly.
